correctness.rationale: On every excursion, normalized age runs from zero to one and the centered spatial reward integrates to zero for any bounded spatial observable. The primitive T H_g(age/T) vanishes at both ends, yielding a pathwise identity across resets. Stationary size-bias and nonarithmetic regenerative mixing give two independent limiting boundary variables; finite E T^3 ensures their squares are integrable. Exact uniform phase integrals produce the variance coefficient; stationary covariance positivity everywhere would contradict bounded integrated variance. New package checker verifies finite cases and exponential example, not the infinite-time limit.

value.rationale: All bounded position observables in this natural first-passage-reset ballistic model have zero complete-cycle fluctuation, forcing O(1/t) rather than generic O(t^-1/2) empirical fluctuations, an endpoint-difference distributional limit (non-Gaussian for normalized position) and a strictly negative covariance at some lag for each nonconstant Lipschitz spatial observable. The result resolves temporal statistics invisible to the known universal stationary marginal, for an infinite family of measurements; this is a motivated structural classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
